kpi_results.kpi: Checklist items left after an erasure for covered types
kpi_results.actual: The stored files of the four sources (lead files, email, chat and ticket attachments) that the CRM owns are deleted after the commit; a failed delete stays queued on the request and is counted until a retry deletes it. Files the CRM must not delete (another host or bucket, another firm's prefix, or an object another retained record uses) are kept, resolved and read-only, with their reason (real-DB suite, including two concurrent erasures sharing one file). Email records, tickets, chats, feedback, notifications, drafts, calendar events and experiment assignments are erased in the transaction (#1361).

The communications and the stored-file queue run inside the erasure transaction (rollback test passes: no queue row, locators intact); the storage deletes cannot join it, run after the commit and never fail the committed erasure

Every branch of the classifier, the plan and queue, the outbox repository, the cleanup service, the storage adapter delete and the service and router changes has a unit or real-DB test; the package figure is measured by pre-ship coverage

definition_of_done_items.criterion: Email records (To/CC/BCC match), tickets, chats, feedback, staff notifications about the person and their deals, auto-response and contact reply drafts and calendar events are anonymised or deleted in the erasure transaction (#1361)

Stored files (lead files, email, chat and ticket attachments) are deleted from object storage in a tracked follow-up step: queued in the erasure transaction, deleted after the commit with bounded retries, failures recorded on the request
Legal holds respected once a hold registry exists (none exists yet; the no-hold confirmation is the check)
The checklist shows only what remains (deals, tasks, stored files not deleted), per source, 0 when all are deleted
Real-DB tests (pnpm test:integration suites dsar-communications and dsar)

notes: Two PRs: #1361 (communications in the erasure transaction) and the follow-up on branch feat/ifc-316b-erase-stored-files (stored files). Adds the dsar_stored_objects table (additive migration 20261127110000). Lead, chat and ticket files have no CRM upload path today, so their locators are recognised by shape: a path under the firm's own prefix in CRM_FILES_BUCKET (default crm-files) or a URL of this project's storage naming one. The CRM deletes only files it alone owns (in its bucket, under the firm's prefix, used by no retained record). Everything else is kept, read-only and resolved: SHARED_KEPT (another retained record uses it) or UNMANAGED (outside the CRM's storage), with no locator stored and no delete or confirm action. An erasure from before the queue shows no claim about its files.
